data.text:
I’m in for 15 tons this month, conditional on all five of us explicitly agreeing, and a maximum of 5 each whenever we start at 50 tons. At 50, that limit leaves at least 25, so even without external replenishment we’ll recover to at least 50 next month.

Let’s keep those limits unless we unanimously agree to a change before choosing, and review any departures once catches are revealed. That gives us a clear plan without pretending anyone can enforce it. Jack, will you join us on those terms?
